Nadia: Quick help — MeridianBank POC reporting 2–5s first-token delays and intermittent 429s during demo load. They switched to hosted this morning. Can SE/SRE triage?
Omar: On it. Any sample logs or model name?
Nadia: They sent: `POST /v1/generate 200 OK first_token=2.3s total=3.1s` model xlarge-v1. No streaming.
Priya: 2.3s suggests cold KV or batching waits. Any cache metrics?
sec-bot: [metric] meridian-poc prefill_cache_miss=71% kv_hits=29% rate_limit_trips=3
Rashid: High prefill miss rate + recent variant change to non-quantized could explain kernel warmup. Also check prompt prefixes for dynamic tokens.
Omar: Customer confirms they include timestamps in the prompt prefix. We'll ask them to swap to placeholders.
Priya: Temporary fix: enable low-latency route and run 10 warmup calls with stable prefix. I'll open ticket ROV-701 for routing override (active 2 hours).
Nadia: They asked if warmup will cost extra. Is there any credit?
Priya: Hosted charges tokens; sales-ops can submit a small credit. I'll note it.
Rashid: Recommend: 1) replace dynamic prefix with placeholder, 2) run warmup script (I'll provide), 3) consider xlarge-q for latency-sensitive demos.
Omar: Warmup curl snippet I'll DM. Sec question: do we store prompts unencrypted?
sec-bot: Hosted encrypts in transit and at rest; keys in HSM; for exclusive control use Dedicated with CMK.
Nadia: I'll send action items and request a 30-min repro window. Priya, paste the routing ticket once ready.
Priya: Routing override ROV-701 created. Monitoring now.
Nadia: Thanks team — will update customer. :thumbsup:
